question: Service Canada denied my EI claim. How long do I have to ask them to reconsider?
generated_answer: You have 30 days from the date on the decision letter to ask Service Canada to reconsider your claim. You can ask them to reconsider by mail or by fax. You can also ask them to reconsider by going to a Service Canada Centre. If you ask them to reconsider, you must give them any new information that you think will help your case. You can also ask them to reconsider if you think they made a mistake when they made their decision. If you ask them to reconsider, Service Canada will look at your case again and make a new decision. If you are not happy with the new decision, you can appeal it to the Social Security Tribunal of Canada.
